## subset to NOM
```{r}
NOM_patients <- clean_s[clean_s$initial_planoutcomes == 2, ]
NOM_patients <- NOM_patients[!is.na(NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes), ]
```

## additional cleaning (same as EDA)

#### 1. status
```{r}
NOM_patients$status <- ifelse(
  is.na(NOM_patients$interval_typeoutcomes),
  0,
  NOM_patients$interval_typeoutcomes
)

# Parse index date (strip time, then Date)
NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes <- gsub(" .*", "", NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes)
NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes <- as.Date(NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# Parse appendectomy date (blank -> NA)
NOM_patients$appy_int_dateoutcomes[NOM_patients$appy_int_dateoutcomes == ""] <- NA
NOM_patients$appy_int_dateoutcomes <- as.Date(NOM_patients$appy_int_dateoutcomes, format = "%Y-%m-%d")

# Time-to-appendectomy (days)
NOM_patients$time_to_appy <- as.numeric(NOM_patients$appy_int_dateoutcomes - NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes)

# Administrative censoring beyond 365 days
NOM_patients$status365 <- ifelse(
  !is.na(NOM_patients$time_to_appy) & NOM_patients$time_to_appy > 365,
  0,
  NOM_patients$status
)
NOM_patients$status365 <- ifelse(is.na(NOM_patients$status365), 0, NOM_patients$status365)

table(NOM_patients$status)
table(NOM_patients$status365)
```


#### 2. outcome
```{r}
EARLY_CUTOFF_DAYS <- 30

NOM_patients$outcome4 <- NA_character_
NOM_patients$outcome4[NOM_patients$status365 == 0] <- "No follow up App. (Baseline)"
NOM_patients$outcome4[NOM_patients$status365 == 1] <- "Elective App."

# urgent split early vs late by time_to_appy
is_urgent <- NOM_patients$status365 == 2
NOM_patients$outcome4[is_urgent & !is.na(NOM_patients$time_to_appy) &
  NOM_patients$time_to_appy <= EARLY_CUTOFF_DAYS] <- "Early and Urgent App."
NOM_patients$outcome4[is_urgent & !is.na(NOM_patients$time_to_appy) &
  NOM_patients$time_to_appy > EARLY_CUTOFF_DAYS] <- "Late and Urgent App."

# Keep only rows where outcome4 is defined
NOM_patients <- NOM_patients[!is.na(NOM_patients$outcome4), ]
NOM_patients$outcome4 <- relevel(factor(NOM_patients$outcome4),
  ref = "No follow up App. (Baseline)"
)

table(NOM_patients$outcome4)
```



#### 3. others
```{r}
# Race/Ethnicity collapse
NOM_patients$RaceEthnicity <- ifelse(
  NOM_patients$RaceEthnicity == "Multiracial",
  "Other/Not Specified",
  NOM_patients$RaceEthnicity
)
NOM_patients$RaceEthnicity <- factor(NOM_patients$RaceEthnicity)

# Sex
NOM_patients$Sex <- factor(NOM_patients$Sex)

# ESL
NOM_patients$ESL <- factor(NOM_patients$ESL)

# CCI
NOM_patients$ccioutcomes <- factor(NOM_patients$ccioutcomes)

# Appendicolith
NOM_patients$appendicolithoutcomes <- factor(NOM_patients$appendicolithoutcomes,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c("Not Present", "Present")
)

# Continuous predictors
NOM_patients$ageoutcomes <- as.numeric(NOM_patients$ageoutcomes)
NOM_patients$appy_sizeoutcomes <- as.numeric(NOM_patients$appy_sizeoutcomes)
NOM_patients$wbcoutcomes <- as.numeric(NOM_patients$wbcoutcomes)

# NLR had blanks in your EDA
NOM_patients$nlroutcomes[NOM_patients$nlroutcomes == ""] <- NA
NOM_patients$nlroutcomes <- as.numeric(NOM_patients$nlroutcomes)
```

## Model

#### Model 1: Symptom-driven appendectomy vs none


```{r}
# NOM_patients$ageoutcomes


# outcome: use the NOM-specific variable
NOM_patients$y_symptom <- as.integer(NOM_patients$symptom_driven_appy)

dat_symptom_wbc <- NOM_patients[, c(
  "y_symptom",
  "ageoutcomes", "Age_Categories", "Sex", "RaceEthnicity", "ESL", # using continous age
  "ccioutcomes",
  "appendicolithoutcomes",
  "bmioutcomes",
  "wbcoutcomes"
)]
na_n <- colSums(is.na(dat_symptom_wbc))
na_prop <- colMeans(is.na(dat_symptom_wbc))
na_summary <- data.frame(
  column = names(na_n),
  na_n = as.integer(na_n),
  na_prop = na_prop
)
na_summary <- na_summary[order(-na_summary$na_n), ]
na_summary

dat_symptom_wbc <- na.omit(dat_symptom_wbc)

fit_symptom_wbc <- glm(
  y_symptom ~ ageoutcomes + Sex + RaceEthnicity + ESL +
    ccioutcomes + appendicolithoutcomes + wbcoutcomes,
  data = dat_symptom_wbc,
  family = binomial()
)

table_model1 <- tbl_regression(fit_symptom_wbc, exponentiate = TRUE)

summary(fit_symptom_wbc)
exp(cbind(OR = coef(fit_symptom_wbc), confint(fit_symptom_wbc)))
nrow(dat_symptom_wbc)
```

```{r}
library(broom)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# helper: make OR + 95% CI table from a glm
or_df <- function(fit) {
  broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
    filter(term != "(Intercept)")
}

# helper: nicer labels (edit if you want)
clean_term <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("RaceEthnicity", "Race: ", x)
  x <- gsub("SexMale", "Sex: Male", x)
  x <- gsub("ESLYes", "ESL: Yes", x)
  x <- gsub("appendicolithoutcomesPresent", "Appendicolith: Present", x)
  x <- gsub("ccioutcomes", "CCI: ", x)
  x <- gsub("Age_Categories", "Age", x)
  x <- gsub("bmioutcomes", "BMI", x)
  x <- gsub("wbcoutcomes", "WBC", x)
  x
}

# helper: forest plot
forest_plot <- function(fit, title_text) {
  df <- or_df(fit) |>
    mutate(
      term = clean_term(term),
      term = reorder(term, estimate) # order y by OR
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    geom_point(color = "#0072B2") +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),
      height = 0.2, color = "#0072B2"
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = "Adjusted Odds Ratio (log scale)",
      y = NULL
    )
}

# --- Two separate graphs ---
p1 <- forest_plot(fit_symptom_wbc, "Model 1: Symptom-driven appendectomy vs none")
p2 <- forest_plot(fit_urgent_wbc, "Model 2: Urgent appendectomy vs none (elective removed)")

p1 +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.1, 10)) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10))

p2 +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.1, 10)) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10))
```


```{r}
# ---- Multiple testing correction (with package check) ----
needed_pkgs <- c("broom", "dplyr", "ggplot2")
to_install <- needed_pkgs[!vapply(needed_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(to_install) > 0) install.packages(to_install)

library(broom)
library(dplyr)

# Reuse clean_term() from above; define if not available
if (!exists("clean_term")) {
  clean_term <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("RaceEthnicity", "Race: ", x)
    x <- gsub("SexMale", "Sex: Male", x)
    x <- gsub("ESLYes", "ESL: Yes", x)
    x <- gsub("appendicolithoutcomesPresent", "Appendicolith: Present", x)
    x <- gsub("ccioutcomes", "CCI: ", x)
    x <- gsub("Age_Categories", "Age", x)
    x <- gsub("bmioutcomes", "BMI", x)
    x <- gsub("wbcoutcomes", "WBC", x)
    x
  }
}

mt_results <- bind_rows(
  broom::tidy(fit_symptom_wbc, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(model = "Model 1: Symptom-driven vs none")
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(term_clean = clean_term(term)) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  mutate(
    p_bonf_model = p.adjust(p.value, method = "bonferroni"),
    p_fdr_model  = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    p_bonf_global = p.adjust(p.value, method = "bonferroni"),
    p_fdr_global  = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
    sig_fdr_model = p_fdr_model < 0.05
  )

mt_results %>%
  select(
    model, term_clean, estimate, conf.low, conf.high,
    p.value, p_bonf_model, p_fdr_model, p_bonf_global, p_fdr_global,
    sig_fdr_model
  ) %>%
  arrange(model, p_fdr_model)
```


```{r}
# ---- Revised forest plot (uses FDR-adjusted significance) ----
library(ggplot2)

plot_df <- mt_results %>%
  mutate(
    sig_label = ifelse(sig_fdr_model, "FDR < 0.05", "FDR >= 0.05"),
    term_plot = reorder(term_clean, estimate)
  )

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = estimate, y = term_plot, color = sig_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.1, 10)) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FDR < 0.05" = "#0072B2", "FDR >= 0.05" = "gray45")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Model 1 revised forest plot with multiple-testing correction",
    x = "Adjusted Odds Ratio (log scale)",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Significance"
  )
```


```{r}
# ---- Numerical comparison: raw vs multiple-testing adjusted (Model 1) ----
num_compare <- mt_results %>%
  transmute(
    term = term_clean,
    OR = estimate,
    CI_low = conf.low,
    CI_high = conf.high,
    p_raw = p.value,
    p_fdr = p_fdr_model,
    p_bonf = p_bonf_model,
    sig_raw_0.05 = p_raw < 0.05,
    sig_fdr_0.05 = p_fdr < 0.05,
    sig_bonf_0.05 = p_bonf < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_fdr)

num_compare

sig_counts <- num_compare %>%
  summarise(
    n_terms = dplyr::n(),
    n_sig_raw = sum(sig_raw_0.05),
    n_sig_fdr = sum(sig_fdr_0.05),
    n_sig_bonf = sum(sig_bonf_0.05)
  )

sig_counts
```
